description: This file defines the interface `GenericTarget`, which serves as a super type for targets and reply-targets, providing essential information for sending a single message, including methods to get the address and optional header mapping.

classes.name: GenericTarget
classes.description: An interface that provides the basic contract for targets and reply-targets, including methods to retrieve the address and optional header mapping necessary for outbound messaging.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the address for an outbound signal, necessary for message routing.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an optional header mapping for renaming, combining, or otherwise transforming headers for outgoing signals.
